basis: R1 pilot evaluator errors plus explicit detector review diagnostics

interpretation.semantic_conflict: model fields contradicted each other and deterministic rule conservatively returned uncertain
interpretation.two_bay_relation_error: positive two-bay reference was not alerted or was assigned a non-positive spatial relation
interpretation.road_relation_error: positive-road reference was not assigned a reliable positive-road decision
interpretation.zero_categories: zero means not observed/attributable in this pilot, not proof of absence in real deployment
